rule: Owner decisions O100 and O103 (2026-10-28): every note an AA capture records is registered here by its exact text and classified once by an editor: 'pricing omission' (AA says its published cost omits a pricing term; O94), with the largest factor of at least 1 the note states for that term or null when it states none (O98: the row then competes over [C, infinity)), or 'not a pricing omission', with a reason. This covers every footnote on any point of the Intelligence Index chart capture now and, from the first capture later than the 2026-10-25T09:56:47Z release captures, the notes AA prints on model pages, the Coding Agent Index and the cost charts (O103). The build stops on any unregistered or changed note, on a ranked row whose reconciliation-inventory note differs from the chart capture, and on a post-O103 capture that records no notes. A note printed for a whole chart or index names no row, so as a pricing omission it must list the configurations it applies to (appliesTo); only the charts and index admitted to the ranking's cost workload count (O106, O108, O109); every configuration an appliesTo list names must be in the cohort; notes that count for nothing are published as disclosures.
